integrity: The proof derives the quotient, cyclic derived subgroup, determinant commutator pairing, graph blow-up, degree distribution, and isoclinism maps directly. A standalone exhaustive checker verifies representative prime and composite derived-group orders and an explicit nonisomorphic same-graph pair.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires finite nonabelian two-generated groups of nilpotency class two.
For generator rank at least three, the commutator map can have higher rank and the determinant reduction does not apply.
The exact graph theorem uses standard class-two commutator identities; originality is restricted to the determinant graph classification, degree fingerprint, and isoclinism consequence.
title: Two-generated class-two commuting graphs are determinant blow-ups
